title: Overdrive upload response
description: The service's answer to a successful PUT /v1/rides/{rideId} or PUT /v1/rides/{rideId}/fit (spec §8.3, ADR 0014): 201 with status "stored" the first time a record (or file) is stored, 200 with "already-stored" when the identical body was stored before. A ride counts as uploaded only when both requests have succeeded.

rideId.description: The ride's id, as in the path and in the record's ride.id: 1 to 128 characters from A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ -, starting with a letter or digit (the engine's own ids are ride-<start millis>).

status.description: stored: this request stored it. already-stored: it was stored before, with exactly this body, and nothing changed.
